name: tendata/trade/destination-countries
description: Break down the customs records that match a trade query by destination country, with weight, USD value and shipment count for each country.

hsCode.description: Customs HS code, 4+ digits (e.g. '630492'). A 2-digit chapter code works only combined with productDesc or a company name.

weight.description: Weight range in kilograms, as [min, max].

catalog.description: Data-source side: customs import records or export records.

exporter.description: Exporter company name (min 2 chars). Drop company suffixes and special characters for better matching.

importer.description: Importer company name (min 2 chars). Drop company suffixes and special characters for better matching.

pageSize.description: Rows per page (1-20). Each returned row is billed, so this caps the cost of one call.

sumOfUSD.description: Total USD value range, as [min, max].

startDate.description: Query window start, YYYY-MM-DD. The window may span at most three years.

searchMode.description: Set to FUZZY_SINGLE for single-keyword fuzzy matching; omit for the default smart search.

productDesc.description: Product description keywords; separate multiple keywords with semicolons (e.g. 'electronics; home appliance').

containProducer.description: Include producer companies (available on Russia/Kazakhstan sources).

filterBlankFields.description: Drop records whose named party is blank (e.g. ["importer"]).

optimizationModel.description: Prefer the vendor's optimized data sources.

weightUnitPriceUSD.description: USD unit price per kilogram range, as [min, max].

filterLogisticFields.description: Drop records whose named party is a logistics company (e.g. ["exporter"]). Buyers have reported forwarders still being returned, so screen party names yourself.

quantityUnitPriceUSD.description: USD unit price per quantity range, as [min, max].

pricing.note: Billed per call from metered usage; the reference price is typical.

readme:
# Customs Trade by Destination Country

Break down the customs records that match a trade query by destination country, with weight, USD value and shipment count for each country.

## Pricing

- Inspect reference unit price: $0.016 USD per result.
- Final settlement uses the provider-reported actual cost after strict validation; the reference price is not used to infer the final charge.
